## assets/jewel-medal-1.webp

Use case: stylized-concept. Production website asset, SINGLE isolated photorealistic fantasy ranking medallion. Reference image is STYLE REFERENCE: reproduce the beautiful jewel-and-laurel badge marked 1, not the website or character. Straight-on symmetrical jewel with deep ruby red translucent cabochon crystal, optically deep dark core, luminous colored internal reflections, subtle facets near rim and clean specular highlights. Surrounding detailed sculpted polished yellow gold laurel wreath, many delicate sharply carved overlapping leaves, elegant small crown/leaf finial above, small diamond finial below. Exactly one large elegant ivory serif numeral "1" centered on gemstone, crisp and readable. Rich tangible jewelry craftsmanship like the reference's 1 badge, not flat vector, not cartoon. Single centered medallion occupies 90 percent of square canvas height, equal small transparent padding. Entire complete object visible. Truly transparent background including spaces between leaves. No characters, scene, platform, text other than numeral, orbit rings, floor, glow cloud, or cast shadow outside object. Premium realistic 3D product rendering with dramatic metal reflections suitable on dark emerald velvet website.
